propositions: Create a new `rebar metrics` CLI subcommand that parses `--since/--until` date range and `--output json|text` flags and renders the full metric registry over the specified range.

The metrics command must import `rebar.metrics` package (not just registry) to trigger reader module registration and fully hydrate REGISTRY, then construct a context object carrying `repo_root`, `since`, `until` and pass it to `registry.evaluate(spec, context)` for each MetricSpec.
The command must wrap each `evaluate()` call in try/except to catch compute exceptions and render failing metrics as unavailable rather than crashing the entire command.

JSON output (default) returns `{"since": ..., "until": ..., "metrics": {<id>: {"lens", "source", "confidence", "value"} | {"unavailable": {"reason", "accruing_since"}}, ...}}`; text output prints one human-readable line per metric in registry order.

The dispatch wiring must add an explicit `if sub == "metrics":` arm in `_cli/__init__.py._dispatch()` and register `"metrics"` to the `individual` frozenset in `test_help_overview_coverage.py` so the command is routable and advertised.
The command must NOT import any `rebar.metrics.adapters` module; adapter-backed data reaches only via REGISTRY and the snapshot store, enforced by a source-level scan test.
